lead_headline: Biological Shield Against Pests in Antalya
lead_deck: Antalya Metropolitan Municipality is providing biological protection by releasing gambusia fish into ponds.
lead_body: As part of the fight against mosquitoes and houseflies, the municipality has added biological solutions alongside chemical methods.
The application aims to control pest populations by establishing a natural balance in the region's ponds.
col1_body: 23. Likya Su Yolu Yürüyüşü ve Patara Yörük Göçü gerçekleştirildi.
col3_body: İklim değişikliğiyle mücadele kapsamında COP31 gönüllülük başvuruları alınıyor.
